NVDA.headline: Nvidia reportedly in talks to invest in Firmus Grid
NVDA.summary: Nvidia is reportedly in talks to invest hundreds of millions of dollars in Firmus Grid, an Australian AI cloud firm that abandoned its IPO earlier in October; the size and terms are unknown and Nvidia has not commented. The shares closed at 216.47 USD, down 0.29% today and 4.8% over one month. Sector-wide, CoreWeave's price rise and rate-hike concerns have weighed on AI infrastructure names.

MSFT.headline: Reports on Xbox handheld, Project Helix pricing and Game Pass
MSFT.summary: Reports citing Fortune say Microsoft plans a Xbox handheld for holiday 2027 and Project Helix for 2028, with internal pricing estimates of $1,200 to $1,800; Microsoft has not confirmed these. Other reports suggest a possible à la carte Game Pass and private equity interest in Xbox valued at up to $150 billion. The shares closed at 531.87 USD, down 0.31% today and up 6.03% over one month.

AAPL.headline: OLED iPad mini reports, 6G hiring and iPhone Duo limits
AAPL.summary: Reports say Apple may show an OLED iPad mini on 28 October, though Apple has not confirmed details. Other stories cover a 6G modem engineer job listing, a two-unit purchase limit for the iPhone Duo reportedly in the US and India, and a $5.7 billion patent verdict against Apple that Taction wants increased. The shares closed at 339.5 USD, down 1% today and up 0.15% over one month.

GOOGL.headline: YouTube tests hiding dislike button; trust-related reports
GOOGL.summary: YouTube appears to be testing moving the dislike button into a submenu for some users, according to user screenshots; Google has not commented. Other stories include an NPR investigation into TikTok child-safety warnings that also names Google, and an Android Authority poll on a change linking phone numbers to Google accounts. The shares closed at 340.28 USD, down 1.13% today and 4.14% over one month.

AMZN.headline: Amazon gains from 3M data-centre partnership; wider market mixed
AMZN.summary: Reuters reports 3M expanded its data-centre partnership with Amazon, and 3M shares jumped after raising its profit forecast; no Amazon-specific financial news was given. Other items cover a Bloomberg report on Eric Schmidt's Anthropic stake and a reported God of War TV series recasting. The shares closed at 262.63 USD, up 0.07% today and 1.62% over one month.

META.headline: WhatsApp in-app browser in development; sector rally
META.summary: WhatsApp is reportedly building an optional in-app browser for links on iPhone, with no launch date given. Broader Asian tech stocks rallied on Wednesday, and Meta's results are due soon. The shares closed at 694.25 USD, down 1.59% today and down 6.34% over one month.

AVGO.headline: Reported OpenAI $30bn raise prompts chip stock speculation
AVGO.summary: A Motley Fool feed item reports that OpenAI is reportedly raising $30 billion and asks which chip stock would gain most. The report is unverified in the material provided, and no details on investors, valuation or timing are available. Shares closed slightly lower today at 334.37 USD (-0.07%), down 7.8% over one month and 5.58% over one year, within a 52-week range of 289.96–495.

TSLA.headline: Musk says Tesla and SpaceX exploring possible merger; no deal agreed
TSLA.summary: Elon Musk has said Tesla and SpaceX have each formed special committees to assess a possible merger, which would be one of the largest deals on record, but stressed that nothing has been agreed and there is no guarantee. Any deal would need shareholder approval, including a majority of Tesla's shares, and critics argue it could dilute shareholders. Separately, reports say Musk ordered a slowdown of Starlink services used by Ukraine's military. Shares rose 1.54% today to 373.71 USD, though they are down 13.84% over one year.

TSM.headline: Construction pause after fatal accident; wider chip sector pressure
TSM.summary: TSMC is suspending some construction work at a site in southern Taiwan after an accident killed four workers; few details on cause or scope are given. Chip stocks have weakened, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index down 11.4% in the week per Mitrade, and BTIG warned of a possible prolonged decline. The shares closed at 425.08 USD, up 1.16% today and down 4.51% over one month.

SPCX.headline: Musk says SpaceX and Tesla exploring possible merger
SPCX.summary: Elon Musk says SpaceX and Tesla have each set up committees to explore a possible merger, with no agreement reached and no certainty it will happen. SpaceX reported its first quarterly profit of $4.4 billion for July to September, and shares rose more than 8% after hours. The shares closed at 147.79 USD, down 0.11% today and down 2.67% over one month.
